base_template: Describe a business expansion for {{company_name}} into the city of {{location}}. The HQ network ({{hq_lan_subnet}}/24) and the Branch network ({{branch_lan_subnet}}/24) have been set up but cannot communicate. Investigate and establish secure encrypted connectivity between the two sites.

company_name.instruction: Generate a creative tech company name

hq_public_ip.instruction: A random public-looking IP (e.g. 203.x.x.x, 185.x.x.x), last octet between 2-50

hq_lan_ip.instruction: A private LAN IP in 10.x.x.x range, last octet between 50-150

branch_lan_ip.instruction: A private LAN IP in 172.16.x.x range, last octet between 50-150

expected_solution: Configure pfSense interfaces (WAN/LAN IPs), then set up IPsec Site-to-Site VPN with IKEv2, AES-256, SHA-256, and matching firewall rules on both firewalls.
